description: This file defines a 'Physics' class responsible for managing physics calculations such as gravity, movement, collision detection, friction, and ground detection for a platformer game. It includes logic for resolving collisions horizontally and vertically, applying gravity, and handling grounded state and coyote timers.

classes.name: Physics
classes.description: A class encapsulating physics logic for a platformer game, including gravity application, collision resolution, and movement updates for a player character.

methods.name: constructor()
methods.description: Initializes the Physics instance with gravity, terminal velocity, and friction parameters.

methods.name: resolve(world, player, dt)
methods.description: Updates the player's position and velocity based on physics calculations and collision detection with the world.
